material_recovery.acceptance_rule: materialize only because the literal two-byte candidate exactly matches each canonical path, indexed size, and indexed SHA-256

research_basis.relevance: 0x7075 stores a UTF-8 filename representation, and the APPNOTE expects the same filename storage method in local and central headers.
research_basis.source: PKWARE ZIP APPNOTE, Info-ZIP Unicode Path Extra Field 0x7075

research_basis.relevance: documents O_NOFOLLOW availability used as one layer in final-component symlink refusal.
distinguishes local build records from provenance attestations produced by an identified build platform; rev0869 keeps its provenance-shaped record explicitly unsigned and local.

source_snapshot_refactor.boundary: This is a local consistency and publication check. It is not a hermetic build, independent rebuild, signed provenance, or defense against a fully compromised kernel/build host.
correction: capture the complete directory/file path set before writing
capture SHA-256, size, executable bit, device, inode, mode, mtime, and ctime for every source file
open regular files without following the final symlink where O_NOFOLLOW is available and compare pre-open/fstat identity
stream only bytes that match the captured file identity and SHA-256
recapture and compare the source path/content snapshot after ZIP writing and again after temporary-archive validation
publish atomically outside the source tree
reopen the published path without following symlinks and require the validated temporary inode and SHA-256
source_snapshot_refactor.prior_behavior: the deterministic builder enumerated paths and later reopened mutable source paths; it did not prove that all packaged bytes and the embedded inventory came from one stable invocation-time tree
regressions: same-size content mutation after initial capture must fail without an output
late file addition after initial capture must fail without an output
file-to-symlink swap after initial capture must fail without an output
normal miniature build must report a source snapshot digest and final published-inode/byte verification

zip_path_alias_defect.compatibility_boundary: This is deliberately a strict producer/consumer profile for EvidenceVault-linked ZIPs, not a general-purpose promise to accept every standards-compliant ZIP extension.
correction: reject every local extra field except one exact ZIP64 size record when local fixed-size fields use ZIP64 sentinels
retain exact local/central name, method, CRC, and size equality
zip_path_alias_defect.prior_behavior: rev0868 accepted a syntactically valid fixture whose central directory named local-extra/file.txt while the local header alone carried Info-ZIP Unicode Path extra field 0x7075 with ../escape.txt
zip_path_alias_defect.regression: scripts/validate_constant_recovery_zip_snapshot_rev0869.py generates the local-only 0x7075 fixture, confirms the central view remains safe, and requires rejection specifically for unsupported local extra field 0x7075
zip_path_alias_defect.risk: extractors that honor different pathname sources can disagree about the materialized path even though the validator approved the central-directory name
zip_path_alias_defect.root_cause: local extra fields were read only for ZIP64 sizes; alternate pathname and platform semantics were otherwise ignored
